description: hy-SU and hy-AM are the same locale after canonicalization but are loaded as two separate catalogs. Tiebreakers are mandatory and must be an exact permutation of the LOADED spellings [hy-AM, hy-SU]; the canonical set {hy-AM} would be rejected as incomplete, which is the trap this fixture exists to document. The list order also decides which sibling an ambiguous canonical request lands on - see the deprecated-fallback pair for the controlled flip.
